blocks.title: 🏛️ Canonical Reference & Masterfile Integration
blocks.text: This flagship scheme is comprehensively detailed in the Government Schemes Masterfile (Section: "migrated-schemes-masterfile"). Key highlights and parameters are summarized below.

items: Objective: Provide Rs.3,000/month pension after 60 for unorganized sector workers.
Eligibility: Age 18-40, income up to Rs. 15,000.
Not a member of EPFO, NPS, or income taxpayer.
Key Points: Worker contributes monthly; government matches.
Ensures financial security in old age.
